newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's August CPI rises 13.9 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's August CPI rises 13.9 pct on year.

text.p: Sri Lanka's consumer price index, based on a 12-month moving average, rose 13.9 percent in August year-on-year against 4.8 percent a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said on Monday.
In July, the year-on-year CPI rose 13 percent, the department said.
The August increase was mainly because of higher prices for rice, after a drought led to a drop in the crop, as well as price rises for bread, cigarettes, liquor and firewood, it said.
